methods.name: DescribeApi
methods.description: Discover the methods available in this build and their schema contracts.

methods.name: StartTrace
methods.description: Starts collection for one runtime; a runtime has at most one active trace.

methods.name: StopTrace
methods.description:
Stops admission and replies when the trace is READY, after accepted host
operations and pending device timestamps drain. Cancelling or timing out
this call stops waiting only; the trace keeps draining.

methods.name: GetTrace
methods.description: Non-blocking status. Never stops collection.

methods.name: ListTraceEvents
methods.description: Events of a READY trace in sequence order. Pages are repeatable.

methods.name: ListTraceResourceSnapshots
methods.description: Resource snapshots of a READY trace, oldest first.

methods.name: GetTracePlan
methods.description: One execution plan of a READY trace, by TraceEvent.plan_id.

methods.name: ExportChromeTrace
methods.description: Chrome Trace Event JSON for Perfetto or chrome://tracing, one page per call.

methods.name: AnnotateTrace
methods.description: Records an application-defined range in a COLLECTING trace.

methods.name: GetTraceSummary
methods.description:
Aggregates of a READY trace: slow nodes, operators, calls or activities,
with achieved rates from plan costs. The same records ListTraceEvents returns.

methods.name: ReleaseTrace
methods.description: Stops collection and retires the handle. Idempotent.

methods.name: GetResourceSnapshot
methods.description: On-demand observation. Does not require or start a trace.

methods.name: CreateDebugSession
methods.description:
Attaches to a Graph context and debugs its Execute transaction one node
at a time. Until release, ordinary operations on the context return BUSY.

methods.name: StepDebugSession
methods.description:
Executes one schedule entry, then replies after its observations are
published. Skipped entries dispatch no kernel. Requires PAUSED.

methods.name: ContinueDebugSession
methods.description:
Runs until completion, a breakpoint or a non-finite output, then replies.
Requires PAUSED.

methods.name: GetDebugSession
methods.description: Non-blocking status. Never advances execution.

methods.name: TakeDebugResult
methods.description:
Transfers completed Execute outputs once; repeated take is NOT_FOUND.
Observation reads are independent. Release buffers through ReleaseBuffers.

methods.name: GetDebugPlan
methods.description: The session's execution plan: steps, source node IDs and tensors.

methods.name: ListDebugEvents
methods.description: Published events with their tensor snapshots, oldest first.

methods.name: ReadDebugTensor
methods.description: Raw bytes of one snapshot. Independent of arena reuse.

methods.name: ExportDebugTensor
methods.description:
Copies an AVAILABLE snapshot into a new, independent host buffer. The tensor
works with VxBufferService (CopyTensors, ExportDLPack) and outlives the
session; release it with ReleaseBuffers.

methods.name: SetDebugTensor
methods.description:
Replaces one input value of the paused step, like DAP setVariable: for
example the float reference a quantized layer should see, to measure the
error it adds on its own. CPU/WASM forward sessions compiled with
preserve_node_boundaries only; weights and other constants are refused.
The session is marked modified.

methods.name: GetDebugDecodeState
methods.description:
Stateful Execute targets: each slot's cursor and every KV cache, with whether this
operation has written it yet at the current stop.

methods.name: ReadDebugKVCache
methods.description:
Stateful Execute targets: one slot's rows of one KV cache in logical token order,
read live from the attached context at the current stop. Paged caches are
gathered through the slot's page table. Requires PAUSED or COMPLETED.

methods.name: CancelDebugSession
methods.description:
Cooperative cancellation at a node/readback boundary, not kernel
preemption. Published observations remain readable until release.
Cancelling an Execute target terminates its context; it cannot resume.
Trainer cancellation preserves the existing rollback transaction.

methods.name: ReleaseDebugSession
methods.description:
Cancels accepted work, detaches the execution context and retires the handle.
Idempotent.

methods.name: DecodeTokenBytes
methods.description:
Lossless token-domain bytes. BYTE_LEVEL_DECODE_ONLY or HF_BYTE_LEVEL_BPE
profile required; contextual HF_SENTENCEPIECE_BPE uses DecodeTokens.
Unknown IDs fail the entire request, including when special tokens are skipped.

methods.name: GetModelInfo
methods.description:
Inspect the immutable logical input/output contract without compiling or
executing the model. Symbol names, bounds and divisibility are preserved.

methods.name: CreateExecutionContext
methods.description: Context execution mode and resource limits are fixed at creation.

methods.name: CancelExecutionContext
methods.description:
Cooperative cancellation of the logical context, including queued work.
Already published buffers retain their independent lifetime.

methods.name: GetTensorInteropInfo
methods.description: Query backend representation and producer ordering. No address is returned.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description:
Completes graph execution and device work before returning independent
selected outputs. Only Graph contexts accept this operation.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description:
Runs a bounded chunk of categorical ID generation. Only autoregressive
contexts accept this operation; initial_inputs is required exactly once.

methods.name: PublishContextPrefix
methods.description:
Prefix and slot ownership is separate from graph/generation execution.
Cache configuration is fixed by CreateExecutionContext.limits.cache.

methods.name: WaitRequest
methods.description:
Completes asynchronously when the request becomes terminal. A call deadline
or cancellation ends only this wait; CancelRequest cancels engine work.

methods.name: TakeRequestResult
methods.description:
Transfers the completed packet exactly once. Repeated take is NOT_FOUND.
Caller-owned outputs outlive the request; release them with ReleaseBuffers.

methods.name: TakeBatchWork
methods.description:
Copies a terminal value/result packet and removes it from queue retention.
Returns BUSY for active work and NOT_FOUND after an earlier take/eviction.

methods.name: SerializeGraph
methods.description:
Serialize typed authoring state without requiring weight/scale payloads.
CreateGraphPlan or LoadModel performs binding and semantic validation.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ByteLevelVocabularyToken
messages.description:
Encoded HF ByteLevel vocabulary strings, not predecoded raw bytes. The engine
inverts the fixed byte alphabet for ordinary tokens. Added tokens contribute
their literal UTF-8 content; only entries marked special are skippable.

fields.name: special
fields.description: Requires added=true.

fields.name: byte_level
fields.description:
Complete immutable byte decoding for the supplied IDs. Does not implement
HF normalization, pretokenization, BPE encoding or chat templates.

fields.name: hugging_face_tokenizer_json
fields.description:
Complete Hugging Face tokenizer.json definition (UTF-8, at most 32 MiB).
The engine admits supported ByteLevel or SentencePiece-style BPE models,
including their normalizer, pretokenizer, merges, added tokens and optional
single-sequence postprocessor. Unsupported definitions fail atomically.
No network access or external tokenizer runtime is used after creation.

fields.name: merges
fields.description:
UTF-8 merge lines, ordered by priority. Blank/comment lines, unresolved
pairs and repeated pairs are ignored. Leading U+0120 denotes a space.
Nonempty merges are rejected for the ByteLevel decode-only vocabulary.

fields.name: token_byte_table_complete
fields.description:
All registered IDs have immutable engine-produced raw bytes. This does not
assert a dense/model-complete ID domain or a complete standalone alphabet.

fields.name: byte_alphabet_complete
fields.description: All 256 ordinary single-byte tokens exist.

fields.name: max_tokens
fields.description: Default 256; explicit zero returns empty.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: HF profiles require AUTO; GREEDY/BPE_WORD are legacy-only modes.

fields.name: add_special_tokens
fields.description:
HF profiles use the tokenizer's admitted single-sequence postprocessor when
true. This does not apply a chat template. Legacy profiles have no HF
postprocessor; an omitted field preserves their existing encoding behavior.

fields.name: skip_special_tokens
fields.description:
Default keeps every token. HF special entries are omitted when true;
ordinary added tokens remain literal UTF-8. Legacy skip=true is unsupported.

fields.name: text
fields.description:
Join token bytes, then apply UTF-8 replacement once to the whole message.
ByteLevel preserves BOM and uses no cleanup/normalization. SentencePiece BPE
uses its admitted contextual decoder over the complete sequence and does
not expose independently concatenable token bytes. Legacy removes
a leading UTF-8 BOM from each vocabulary entry before joining, replaces
U+0120 with space afterwards and keeps unknown IDs as empty placeholders.

fields.name: byte_offset
fields.description:
Offsets refer to DecodedTokenBytes.value, in request order. Skipped special
entries have zero byte_length; duplicate IDs remain distinct observations.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Raw joined bytes, including invalid/incomplete UTF-8 and NUL.

fields.name: complete
fields.description:
True only on success after every requested ID resolved. Skipping a known
special entry counts as resolved. Failure publishes no bytes or metadata.

fields.name: max_pages
fields.description: default: fully private slot capacity

fields.name: max_queue_depth
fields.description: default: 4 * slot count

fields.name: token_budget
fields.description: per dispatch, including padding; default 2048

fields.name: max_slots
fields.description: default: cache slots, or 8 without a cache

fields.name: multiple_of
fields.description: stateless batch divisibility; default 1

fields.name: max_wait_ns
fields.description: fill-first only; rounded up to the scheduler clock tick

fields.name: queue_depth_window
fields.description: default 1024 recent rounds

fields.name: retained_results
fields.description: default: 2 * queue depth + slot count

fields.name: cache
fields.description: required for decode work; metadata only

fields.name: model
fields.description: omitted/empty defaults to "default"

fields.name: adapter_revision
fields.description: absence differs from an empty revision

fields.name: shape_signature
fields.description: defaults to "stateless" or "llm"

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: copied at submission, returned unchanged to worker

fields.name: prompt_key
fields.description:
Context-local identity of the complete prompt semantics, including model,
adapter and positional inputs. Only complete prompt pages are published.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: uninterpreted application data, copied at submission

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: queue-scoped, never reused

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: zero for a padding item

fields.name: slot
fields.description: -1 for stateless work

fields.name: pages
fields.description: logical-to-physical pages; -1 is unmapped

fields.name: padding
fields.description: duplicates the first item's inputs; outcome is discarded

fields.name: dispatch_id
fields.description:
Zero means no work is ready. The same nonzero dispatch is returned until
completed; polling never repeats admission or a reservation. Only one
dispatch is exposed at a time. A round visits each ready group once.

fields.name: finished
fields.description: stop decode before max_tokens; ignored for prefill

fields.name: value
fields.description: appended to this request's value history

fields.name: outputs
fields.description: copied; replaces this request's last outputs

fields.name: error
fields.description: any useful item's error fails the entire dispatch

fields.name: outcomes
fields.description:
Exactly one outcome per dispatched item, including padding, unless error
is supplied. Invalid IDs/counts/payloads leave the pending dispatch intact.

fields.name: error
fields.description: worker-wide failure; rolls back reservations

fields.name: worker_busy_ns
fields.description:
Time from first exposure to completion, summed over nonoverlapping worker
dispatches. This measures worker turnaround, not GPU hardware utilization.

fields.name: drain
fields.description:
Stops admission and cancels queued work. With drain, already admitted work
remains available through Next/Complete until terminal. Without drain all
pending work is cancelled and dispatch IDs are revoked. Release always
cancels and frees the policy owner; worker device resources remain its own.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BufferHandle
messages.description:
An owner-scoped capability, never a pointer. Copying an ID does not retain it.
RetainBuffers returns fresh IDs; ReleaseBuffers retires IDs idempotently.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BufferView
messages.description: A range within the public logical extent, not allocation capacity.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.NativeResource
messages.description:
Local transport only. handle is a host/CUDA pointer, VkBuffer, GLuint, or
id<MTLBuffer>. device_context identifies the owning VkDevice/EGLContext/
MTLDevice; CUDA validates its primary context. These are not wire identities.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BorrowedBuffer
messages.description:
Caller-owned local memory. All accesses finish before native dispatch
returns. The caller keeps memory valid and unchanged during the call.
Browser dispatch rejects this descriptor before dereferencing. A remote
native adapter must reject local descriptors before forwarding the call.
Offsets apply to resource contents, never to an opaque object address.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.Tensor
messages.description:
A dense tensor. name is a binding label, not storage identity. It is ignored
by storage operations, and required by model input and output bindings.
Storage ownership belongs exclusively to buffer.buffer_id.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TensorBatch
messages.description: Outputs are independent snapshots unless explicitly documented as shared.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.AllocateBuffersRequest
messages.description:
Allocates zero-initialized CPU storage. Device snapshots are produced by
execution; allocation on arbitrary GPU devices is not yet supported.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CopyTensorsRequest
messages.description:
Produces independent CPU snapshots or explicit host readback. inline_result
returns portable bytes; into specifies one local host destination per source.
Both options cannot be set together. The default returns owned buffer IDs.
Batches validate every source and destination before any destination write.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BufferAccessRequest
messages.description:
Access is an explicit lease. Conflicting writes return BUSY. host_mapping
requires direct CPU access and never introduces a hidden staging copy.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CudaStreamCompletion
messages.description:
Local-native CUDA completion evidence. All accesses must already be queued
on these 1..64 streams, on the allocation's device and primary context.
Keep every stream alive through the call. Values are live CUstream handles,
or 1 for the legacy default stream. Zero and the per-thread stream (2) are
rejected: dispatch may run on another host thread. Capturing streams are
unsupported. Arbitrary integers are not safe substitutes for live handles.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.EndBufferAccessRequest
messages.description:
Retires the access permission; all views bound to it must stop being used.
With cuda, C records stream completion without a host wait and defers the
dependency until this allocation is accessed/reused. Final destruction or
shutdown may wait for recorded work. The caller must declare every stream
that accessed the range, and must enqueue no further accesses. At most 64
distinct pending consumer streams are retained per allocation; exceeding
that budget returns BUSY and leaves the access permission active.
Without cuda, external work must already be complete; native CUDA also drains
the context conservatively. Retired IDs are harmless. Validation failure
leaves live IDs active; a driver failure can add ordering dependencies but
does not retire IDs. CUDA evidence is rejected on WASM/remote transports.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ImportDLPackRequest
messages.description:
A local pointer to a standard DLManagedTensor or DLManagedTensorVersioned.
A successful import consumes its deleter exactly once, on final release.
Failure leaves ownership with the caller. Producer synchronization must be
complete before import. Dense CPU and CUDA tensors are supported.

fields.name: access_id
fields.description:
Optional existing writable BeginBufferAccess lease covering this tensor.
EndBufferAccess ends its permission even if DLPack aliases remain alive;
those aliases only retain allocation lifetime and must no longer be used.
Zero creates the ordinary lease whose permission ends at the deleter.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DLPackExport
messages.description:
The standard DLPack deleter releases the allocation reference and, for an
ordinary export, its writable permission. Scoped permission ends explicitly
via EndBufferAccess. Public IDs may retire earlier. No autograd edge is created.
Keep the native library loaded until every exported deleter has run.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TensorSpec
messages.description:
Logical model contract. Concrete request shapes are carried only by Tensor.
No byte size is reported because a symbolic tensor has many concrete byte
sizes within its bounded domain.

fields.name: device
fields.description: Kind and device identity; handle and size_bytes are zero.

fields.name: consumer_stream
fields.description:
CUDA legacy default stream (DLPack stream value 1); zero otherwise.
Borrowed producers order writes on this stream before Execute.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.AffineQuantization
messages.description:
Resolved per-tensor affine metadata. Numeric values are loaded from the
safetensors tensors referenced by graph.quantization.tensors; they are not
graph JSON parameters.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ShapePlanEvidence
messages.description: Dynamic-shape binding evidence for one committed shape signature.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.RouteEvidence
messages.description:
Which backend actually executed. `attested` is false when any active node
lacked a proved route; a consumer must not read the selected backend as
execution proof without it.

fields.name: last_position
fields.description: Absent before the first successful step.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.Lineage
messages.description:
Immutable identity of the graph, weight, and adapter generations an
operation ran against.

fields.name: graph_plan_id
fields.description:
Nonzero when a planning operation creates or names a positive GraphPlan
id. A stale positive reference is echoed for diagnosis; a constructor
failure before handle allocation and SafeTensors inspection leave zero.
A model-derived plan also carries the retained Model revision above; a
standalone authoring plan leaves those model fields zero.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Machine-readable detail, independent of message wording.

fields.name: input_issue
fields.description:
First input violation, reported before the input batch changes state.
Absent for failures unrelated to input validation. Never infer retry
safety for other failures from the absence of this field.

fields.name: input_index
fields.description: Zero-based index into the supplied batch; absent for a missing input.

fields.name: expected
fields.description: Present when a declared input can be identified.

fields.name: actual
fields.description: Metadata only; no tensor payload is echoed. Absent for missing inputs.

fields.name: required_extent
fields.description: Previously bound extent for symbol equality or decode shape continuity.

fields.name: names_truncated
fields.description:
Runtime evidence bounds names to 255 bytes and symbols to 63 bytes.
Query GetModelInfo for the complete names when this flag is true.

fields.name: actual_rank
fields.description:
Actual rank is preserved even for an invalid native binding exceeding
max_tensor_rank. actual.shape then contains only the first eight axes.

fields.name: compiled_backends
fields.description:
Backends compiled into this library, in canonical lower-case spelling.
Availability at runtime is reported by VxInferenceService.ListBackends.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DescribeApiRequest
messages.description:
Empty filters return the method catalogue for this build. include_types
adds only the transitive request/response types of the selected methods.
A method filter requires a service (e.g. VxInferenceService / Execute).
Unknown or unavailable names return NOT_FOUND, never an empty success.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ApiRule
messages.description:
Fields are proto field paths, relative to the annotated request/message.
REQUIRES means the first non-default/present field requires the remaining
fields. EXACTLY_ONE counts non-default/present fields (including messages).
These discoverable rules supplement the C validator; graph-dependent
validity and backend admission are still decided by the operation.

fields.name: states
fields.description: HANDLE_STATE only: accepted state enum value names.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Scalar protobuf spelling, or a fully-qualified message/enum name.

fields.name: required
fields.description:
True only for explicitly documented semantic requirements. False is
not proof that omission is valid for every operation using this type.

fields.name: proto_default
fields.description: Protobuf default (JSON spelling), distinct from an engine default.

fields.name: engine_default
fields.description: Documented engine behavior when omitted/zero, not a codec substitution.

fields.name: minimum
fields.description:
Inclusive numeric bounds (JSON Schema minimum/maximum), in decimal. Empty
when unbounded. Checked by the engine for the documented operations.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MonotonicTime
messages.description:
Current CLOCK_MONOTONIC reading in nanoseconds. Submit deadlines use this
clock domain. The representation does not imply nanosecond clock precision.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.RuntimeBudget
messages.description:
Queued, in-flight, and caller-retained output batches share these Runtime-wide
bounds. Admission precharges the selected output sum and shrinks that charge
to the completed snapshot bytes. Inline storage returns its reservation after
serialization/discard; owned bytes remain charged through the final storage
lease and the batch slot through the final owned output release.

Every field is optional: an unset field takes the engine default. Defaults
are 64 scheduled requests, 64 MiB scheduled input bytes, zero batch delay,
64 unconsumed results, and 64 MiB unconsumed result bytes.

fields.name: max_batch_delay_ns
fields.description:
Maximum coalescing delay for scheduled requests. Zero dispatches
immediately; deadlines may shorten a nonzero delay.
Rounded up to the scheduler's millisecond coalescing tick; at most
4294967295000000 ns. Representation and scheduling precision are distinct.

fields.name: cpu_threads
fields.engine_default: 0 selects the engine default thread count.

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Absence takes every engine default.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BankResidency
messages.description:
Which slots of a declared weight bank to materialize.

Residency is part of the immutable loaded Model source. Every compiled
context owns a private engine and descriptor table, borrows the compiled
immutable weight blobs, and materializes the same selected rows in a
context-owned copy-on-write overlay. Slot ids are ascending, unique, and
index the bank's current declared extent, not its dimension's append
capacity. Route indices stay in that global slot space at execution, so a
model loaded with a subset still routes by the ids the exporter emitted.
Each present entry names a nonempty strict subset; omit a bank to make every
currently declared slot resident. Duplicate bank entries are invalid.

fields.name: bank
fields.description: Weight tensor named by the graph document's "banks" table.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.LoadModelRequest
messages.description:
graph_path names graph.json or a named *.graph.json document. The loader
requires its root discriminator to be exactly "volvox-graph/v1" and never
searches alternate filenames. weight_paths are retained in order. A bank
left out of bank_residency is fully resident.
Use exactly one of graph_path, graph_document or package. weight_paths may
accompany either graph source, but cannot accompany an inline ModelPackage.

fields.name: source_options
fields.description:
Optional source manifest and byte budgets. Required to opt into the
browser source profile above 64 MiB; cannot accompany inline ModelPackage.
C validates the manifest before browser fetch or snapshot publication.

fields.name: graph_document
fields.description:
Inline volvox-graph/v1 document with optional original weight_paths.
Contains 1..67,108,864 bytes. The loader snapshots these exact bytes;
source_options.graph, when present, describes this document, and totals
include it alongside the ordered path shards. No graph path is required.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ModelSourceIntegrity
messages.description:
Integrity of the complete decoded source body, after HTTP decompression.
C checks SHA-256 against the accepted immutable snapshot. A mismatch
publishes no model handle and releases snapshots from the failed load.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: Exactly 32 raw digest bytes; hexadecimal text is not a digest.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ModelSourceOptions
messages.description:
One graph descriptor and one descriptor per ordered weight path are required.
With graph_document, the graph descriptor hashes those exact inline bytes.
max_shard_bytes also bounds the graph; totals include all source files.
Native path loads without this message keep their filesystem profile.
Browser path loads without it retain the ordinary 64 MiB source budget.
Browser hosts may impose a tighter maxPackageBytes. The WASM32 source
profile admits at most 1 GiB, subject to allocation and device limits.
Source budgets do not reserve prepared weights, activations, execution
scratch or device memory; those costs have separate admission checks.
Large browser sources require streaming bodies. The host forwards bounded
chunks and transfers uniquely staged VFS storage to immutable snapshots.
Accepted descendants retain those snapshots after ReleaseModel.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ModelPackage
messages.description:
Portable source for authoring/export -> inference. The loader snapshots all
bytes before publishing the Model; callers may reuse their buffers after
the call. Descendants retain the accepted snapshot after ReleaseModel.
graph_document uses volvox-graph/v1; shards are ordered SafeTensors files.
Total graph + shard bytes must be <= 64 MiB on every transport. A web host
may impose a tighter maxPackageBytes. No path resolution or fetch occurs.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.PublishAdapterRequest
messages.description:
Publishing another package under the same adapter_name creates the next
immutable revision of that adapter.

fields.name: package_path
fields.description:
Empty publishes a metadata-only route revision, which is useful to
providers that own adapter storage.

fields.name: version_name
fields.description: Empty uses the package/provider version.

fields.name: backends
fields.description:
PREFER tries this ordered list. REQUIRE accepts exactly one entry. An
empty list selects the host's default ordered backend policy. A populated
list has at most 16 unique names. Each name is 1..63 ASCII characters,
begins with a lower-case letter, and then contains only lower-case letters,
digits, dot, underscore, or dash.
fields.engine_default: The host's default ordered backend policy.

fields.name: preserve_node_boundaries
fields.description:
Compile a separate executable that preserves source node boundaries for
debugging. Disables fusion and alias elimination, not arena reuse. The
selected backend must support this graph; there is no implicit CPU route.

fields.name: adapter_revision
fields.description:
Absent selects the immutable base revision. Present pins one exact
adapter revision published by this Model; contexts cannot rebind it.

fields.name: packed_arithmetic
fields.description: Resolved immutable arithmetic; UNSPECIFIED is never returned on success.

fields.name: active_lengths_input
fields.description:
Required I32[slots] graph input carrying positive initialized lengths.
This is an explicit control binding, never inferred from padding/shape.

fields.name: position_input
fields.description: Optional graph input carrying the model's position values.

fields.name: update_inputs
fields.description: Input roots refreshed by row transitions, including retained values.

fields.name: position_input
fields.description: At least one explicit position/active-length control binding is required.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.FullPrefixGenerationContract
messages.description:
Re-evaluate the complete growing prefix for every selected ID. This profile
has no persistent attention/recurrent cache and requires a stateless graph
with EVALUATE/FULL initialization and transition entrypoints. Initial inputs
contain exactly the active prompt, with no inactive/padded suffix. All
unlisted inputs must be fixed-shape invariant_inputs retained from that
first call. Every growing dimension shares token_input's sequence symbol.
Initial bindings must be host-readable. CPU/WASM/CUDA execute the complete
graph; CUDA samples/selects on device and transfers the selected ID for
prefix construction. Chunk IDs, including owned tensors, use host storage.

fields.name: position_input
fields.description: Required I32[S]; retain the prompt values and append the last value + 1.

fields.name: sequence_input
fields.description: Optional I32[S], required to equal arange(S); extend it with the new index.

fields.name: chunk_mask_input
fields.description:
Optional I32[1,S,S] keep mask: one exactly when query/key are in the
same chunk. Causality remains the attention operator's declared policy.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.description: Positive iff chunk_mask_input is present.

fields.name: zero_append_inputs
fields.description: Optional I32[S] or I32[1,S] controls; retain the prompt and append zero.

fields.name: multimodal_position_input
fields.description:
Optional I32[3,S]; append one plus the maximum existing value to all
three axes, preserving multimodal prompt positions and text continuation.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.IncrementalGenerationContract
messages.description:
Additional feedback controls for the incremental row profile. Inputs have
the admitted fixed sequence capacity; initialization consumes only the
prefix selected by incremental.active_lengths_input. Each transition writes
the newly active row without changing or recomputing earlier token rows.
Unlisted conditioning inputs must be declared invariant_inputs.

fields.name: position_input
fields.description: Required I32[S]; append the last active position + 1.

fields.name: sequence_input
fields.description: Optional I32[S]; write the new absolute sequence index.

fields.name: chunk_mask_input
fields.description: Optional I32[1,S,S] mask; update the new query/key chunk memberships.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.description: Positive iff chunk_mask_input is present.

fields.name: zero_append_inputs
fields.description: Optional I32[S] or I32[1,S] routing controls; append zero.

fields.name: multimodal_position_input
fields.description:
Optional I32[3,S]; append one plus the maximum active position across
the three axes, preserving prepared multimodal prompt positions.

fields.name: token_output
fields.description: Graph ArgMax/QArgMax I32 output used for engine feedback.

fields.name: id_domain_size
fields.description: IDs are in [0, id_domain_size).

fields.name: output_name
fields.description: Public chunk output; phase one is I32[1,T], sequence_axis=1.

fields.name: full_prefix
fields.description:
Presence selects the explicit whole-prefix profile. Absence retains the
incremental row profile and its state/cache contract.

fields.name: incremental_controls
fields.description:
Optional controls for the incremental state/cache profile. Mutually
exclusive with full_prefix; absence preserves the original dense profile.

fields.name: sampling
fields.description:
Explicit GREEDY or RANDOM is required. RANDOM requires F32 categorical
logits with at most 1,048,576 categories and an admitted CPU/WASM/CUDA
sampling route. Admitted full-prefix GREEDY routes also support EOS,
stop IDs and ID sequences on Vulkan, OpenGL, Metal and WebGPU.

fields.name: max_steps
fields.description: Total newly selected IDs, excluding conditioning/prefill.

fields.name: seed
fields.description:
RANDOM defaults to seed zero. Reproducibility is scoped to the same model,
input, backend and configuration, independent of Generate chunk boundaries.
The RNG advances once per newly selected ID. GREEDY rejects a seed.

fields.name: stop_ids
temperature
fields.description:
RANDOM-only options. Temperature must be finite and strictly positive.
Explicit temperature zero is invalid; use GREEDY.

fields.name: top_k
fields.description:
Zero selects the entire categorical domain; positive values retain the
highest scoring IDs, ordered by score then ascending ID for ties.

fields.name: top_p
fields.description:
Retain the smallest descending-score prefix whose probability reaches this
threshold, including the crossing ID, after top-k filtering. Must be finite
and strictly positive, at most one.

fields.name: eos_ids
fields.description: EOS takes precedence over ID_STOP when both match the same generated ID.

fields.name: max_memory_bytes
fields.description:
Context state/cache/scratch, excluding weights and retained outputs.
Absence uses the admitted backend/runtime resource domain.

fields.name: bindings_available
fields.description: False initially and after an executed stateless request is discarded.

fields.name: names
fields.description:
Empty explicitly selects no outputs. Names must be unique public outputs
of the selected entrypoint, or of the model's generation contract.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Must equal this slot's next active position; zero is a valid position.

fields.name: roots
fields.description: Includes every changed input root. Empty requires no changed binding.

fields.name: max_output_bytes
fields.description:
Selected output payload only. Absent uses the runtime's available output
budget; present values must be positive, also for an empty selection.

fields.name: deadline_monotonic_ns
fields.description:
Absolute VxPlatformService monotonic nanoseconds. A present zero value
is invalid. Before commit: refuse unchanged; after commit: FAILED and no
output handoff. Unsupported clocks/deadlines are refused at admission.

fields.name: max_steps
fields.description: New IDs in this chunk, excluding prefill; must be positive.

fields.name: deadline_monotonic_ns
fields.description: Same absolute clock and failure semantics as ExecutionBudget.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Absent selects all public outputs; present empty selects none.

fields.name: storage
fields.description:
UNSPECIFIED defaults to INLINE. OWNED_BUFFER requires support from this
transport/backend and keeps an independent snapshot on its backend.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: Values, reuse and feedback bind every entrypoint input exactly once.

fields.name: initial_inputs
fields.description:
Required before initialization, including an explicitly empty message;
forbidden afterward. List emptiness does not select an execution mode.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Newly committed categorical IDs in this call; zero for ordinary graph work.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: A context terminal reason; chunk budget exhaustion leaves it unspecified.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecuteResponse
messages.description:
Every tensor is complete and independently owned. Release buffer outputs
with ReleaseBuffers. Failure or cancellation transfers no graph outputs.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GenerateResponse
messages.description:
Failure transfers no outputs. Cancellation may return already committed
generation IDs with a successful report and terminal CANCELLED progress.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecutionPacket
messages.description: Scheduler response envelope; it adds no execution operation or lifecycle.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ContextCacheOptions
messages.description:
Fixed at context creation. Materialized atomically by initialization;
allocation/admission failure preserves the uninitialized context.

fields.name: max_pages
fields.description: Omitted uses all complete physical pages in the admitted tensor pool.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Context-local identity. Include every input value affecting the prefix.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: Must end at a complete page. Published pages remain immutable through COW.

fields.name: slot
fields.description:
Must be empty, for example after ReleaseContextSlot. C restores the saved
decoder-input/output prefix as well as shared K/V pages. Other slots and
independently retained output buffers remain unchanged.

fields.name: free_pages
fields.description: Reclaim unused prefixes in LRU order until this many pages are free.

fields.name: pages
fields.description: Logical page -> physical page; -1 means unmapped.

fields.name: logical_bytes
fields.description:
Logical/resident counts describe page use, not GPU allocations. Pool
storage stays allocated until the context closes; snapshots are separate.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.SubmitOptions
messages.description:
Priority is clamped to [-1000, 1000]. Higher values run first; queued age
raises effective priority, and equal effective priorities use
earliest-deadline-first, then request id.

fields.name: deadline_monotonic_ns
fields.description:
Absolute monotonic nanoseconds in the VxPlatformService clock domain.
Rounded up to the scheduler clock tick.
Zero disables the deadline. It is always an admission/EDF target; only
DROP_IF_LATE makes it a hard queued/completion cutoff.

fields.name: stream_key
fields.description: Required and nonzero for LATEST. Numeric identity copied by value.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.SubmitRequest
messages.description:
Acceptance snapshots inputs and reserves exactly one context and the output
budget atomically. ALL accepts both operations. LATEST/DROP_IF_LATE accept
only stateless evaluate/full with complete new values, never reuse/feedback.
Refusal precedes replacing any existing request. Same-context resubmission
is BUSY; LATEST matching uses compiled route and stream key across contexts.

fields.name: status
fields.description: BUSY while queued or running; otherwise the terminal execution status.

fields.name: deadline_missed
fields.description:
Set when accepted work crossed its target. ALL and LATEST still publish a
successful result; DROP_IF_LATE instead reports DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.PerTensorAffineQuantization
messages.description:
Exact affine values hydrated from the tensors named by the logical graph.
Scales are finite and positive. Per-axis scales and zero points have equal,
nonzero lengths, and axis is in the target tensor's normalized rank.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TensorAffineQuantization
messages.description:
tensor_name is nonempty and unique in GraphPlanningSource, and the set must
match the graph document's affine descriptors exactly. Request order is
immaterial. Numeric values are validated against the descriptor tensors
represented by PlanningWeight.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.PlanningWeight
messages.description:
Weight descriptors are separate because volvox-graph/v1 deliberately does
not repeat fixed weight dtype and shape metadata from SafeTensors. Names are
unique, contain no U+0000, and occupy 1..127 UTF-8 bytes. dtype is one of
F16, BF16, F32, I32, I8, or U8; F16/BF16 storage is normalized to logical F32. A shape
has at most eight axes, an empty shape denotes a scalar, and every present
extent is in [1, 2,147,483,647]. One tensor's packed storage span is at most
4,294,967,295 bytes. Request order is immaterial and the resulting plan uses
canonical tensor order.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphPlanningSource
messages.description:
Standalone authoring source. graph_document contains 1..67,108,864 exact
UTF-8 JSON bytes of one volvox-graph/v1 document. The sum of every
PlanningWeight packed storage span is at most 9,223,372,036,854,775,807
bytes. The request snapshots every field before return; no caller buffer or
object is retained.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphDefinition
messages.description:
Typed construction of the same logical graph accepted as graph_document.
C owns normalization, generated node IDs, validation and fingerprinting.
Missing multiple_of means one. An omitted node ID selects the first unused
node_N, reserving all explicit IDs before assigning any generated ID.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphParameter
messages.description:
name is the source parameter spelling in the operator registry. Semantic
plans return its normalized NodeParameter; these are deliberately distinct.

fields.name: operator_name
fields.description:
PackedLinear is inference-only with params group_size=32, 64, 128 or 256,
weight_bits=2, 3, 4 (default) or 8. Arithmetic belongs to CompileModelRequest.
Its F32 input [...,K] produces F32 out [...,N]. Immutable weight is
I32[N,ceil(K*weight_bits/32)], with least significant codes first.
Signed value = code - 2^(weight_bits-1). W3 is a dense bitstream: a code
can cross a word boundary; unused high bits in the final word are zero.
Other widths pad unused tail codes with the encoded signed zero.
Thus W2 stores sixteen codes per word, padded with 2;
W4 stores eight nibbles per word, padded with 8; W8 stores four
bytes per word, padded with 128. Scale is positive finite
F32[N,ceil(K/group_size)], shared within each logical K group.
Grouping does not change row packing: only the final word is padded.
group_size is stored quantization geometry, independent of execution tiles;
changing it requires refitting scales/codes, never reinterpreting an artifact.
Optional immutable bias is F32[N]. No affine tensor metadata is applied.
For F16, input and (signed weight * scale) round to IEEE FP16, ties-even,
before FP32 multiply/accumulation. Overflow follows IEEE FP16 semantics.
For DYNAMIC_I8, each input row uses scale_a=max(max(abs(input))/127,2^-126), or
1 for a zero row. Round input/scale_a ties-even and clamp to [-127,127].
Each group computes an exact INT32 dot, then FP32(dot)*(scale_a*scale).
Group results accumulate in FP32; bias is added once after accumulation.
F32 reconstructs weights in F32 and accumulates F32 products. F32_FAST
also permits the compensated TF32 path described by PackedArithmetic.
A nonfinite original input produces NaN outputs for its row in every mode.
Parallel FP32 reductions may round differently across backends.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.EditGraphPlanRequest
messages.description:
One immutable topology transaction. Edits apply in order to a private C
draft; references may be temporarily broken. C validates the final graph
once and publishes a new standalone plan only on success. The source plan
and all existing readers remain unchanged on success or failure. Removing
an absent item is a no-op; replacing an unknown node is an error. An omitted
replacement ID keeps the selected ID. An empty edit list clones the source.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CreateGraphPlanRequest
messages.description:
Exactly one source is required. A model source pins that exact immutable
graph, weight, and adapter revision. A standalone source is independent of
any Runtime and is suitable for offline authoring. Definition normalization
is a constructor invariant: an invalid source returns a failed report with
no handle or partial GraphPlan. A well-formed definition whose bounded shape
domain is unsupported still creates a readable plan with a typed refusal.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphDimension
messages.description:
Names are nonempty, unique, and emitted in UTF-8 byte order. Bounds and
multiple_of are positive integers no greater than 9,007,199,254,740,991,
minimum <= maximum, and the closed interval contains at least one multiple
of multiple_of. Those multiples, rather than every integer in the interval,
are the dimension's legal values.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphAxis
messages.description:
One declared logical axis. Fixed extents are positive. A symbolic axis has a
nonempty name that joins exactly one GraphDimension; bounds live only in
that canonical table.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphTensorRef
messages.description:
References repeat the canonical name beside the dense index so generated
consumers remain readable while still detecting a stale or mismatched join.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphPlanOutputRef
messages.description:
Reverse reference into GraphPlan.outputs. Message presence distinguishes a
public output at index zero from a tensor that is not a public output.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphTensor
messages.description:
A present storage_alias_root says the planner proved this tensor is a
byte-identical logical view of that canonical root over the complete
accepted domain. The root itself has no storage_alias_root, so alias chains
are already collapsed. A provider may share storage or materialize a copy;
no physical address or allocation requirement is implied. producer and
public_output are reverse indexes into GraphNode.outputs and
GraphPlan.outputs respectively; both directions must agree exactly.

fields.name: canonical_birth_step
fields.description:
INPUT and WEIGHT birth is -1; VALUE birth is its producer's schedule
index. WEIGHT last use is -1 because weight residency is described
separately. For every other tensor, last use is its greatest consuming
schedule index, -1 for an unused non-output INPUT, or node_count when the
tensor is a public output retained through the caller boundary.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ShapeExpressionAxis
messages.description:
One source-level axis in an operator shape parameter. Unlike GraphAxis, a
literal is signed and may be zero because operators such as Reshape assign
meaning to 0 and -1 sentinels. A symbolic value joins one GraphDimension;
the operator registry and its shape function define which literals are
legal for each parameter.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.NodeParameterValue
messages.description:
Canonical typed source-declared operator parameter. The generated registry
selects the arm, rather than the lexical JSON representation: accepted
boolean/integer and scalar/list aliases therefore converge to one value.
number_value is the registry's exact F32 value. JSON objects are not a
supported parameter form.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.NodeParameter
messages.description:
canonical_name is the registry json_name for an ordinary parameter and the
stable alias-group id for mutually exclusive source aliases. It therefore
describes semantic meaning and is not necessarily the member spelling that
appeared in the source JSON. A registry-authorized JSON null has the same
meaning as omission and is therefore absent from GraphNode.parameters.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphNode
messages.description:
Ports and parameters use canonical UTF-8 port/canonical_name order.
schedule_index is dense execution order; definition_index points back to
the source graph.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphWeightBank
messages.description:
One logical bank declaration. tensor is a rank-two-or-greater WEIGHT whose
first axis is the bank's current declared slot count. That fixed extent must
be a legal value of the joined GraphDimension, whose maximum is at most
2,147,483,647. The dimension's maximum is append capacity, not current
extent; adding slots within it may preserve graph topology but creates a new
planning snapshot. Valid global slot ids are [0, tensor.shape[0]). Residency
is deliberately absent: it is a concrete binding choice reported by
ResolvedWeightBank, not graph topology.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ResidentSlotSubset
messages.description:
The partial form is a nonempty strict subset of the bank's current declared
slots. Slots are ascending, unique, in [0, GraphWeightBank.tensor.shape[0]),
and remain in the graph's global slot space.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ResolvedWeightBank
messages.description:
Concrete residency for exactly one GraphWeightBank. tensor and dimension
must match that declaration. Exactly one residency form is present. Full
residency means every currently declared slot and is represented without
enumerating them. For a partial bank, resident tensor row i represents
global slot partial.slots[i].

fields.name: node
fields.description:
Both references are optional. Their absence denotes a graph-wide
diagnostic; when present they join this GraphPlan exactly.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ShapeDimensionRelation
messages.description:
The target is defined by exactly one constant, source symbol, or affine
source-plus-offset expression. A self witness sets symbol == target.

fields.name: facts
fields.description: Nonempty, ascending, unique, and never UNSPECIFIED.

fields.name: proof_identity
fields.description:
Stable identity of this exact complete-domain proof, independent of the
process-local GraphPlan handle that exposes it. Within one plan_identity,
equal non-identity proof fields produce the same proof_identity.

fields.name: relations
fields.description: Unique targets in GraphPlan dimension order.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ShapeDomainRefusal
messages.description:
A refusal is emitted only after definition normalization succeeded and the
bounded-domain proof reached a canonical semantic terminal.

fields.name: proof_identity
fields.description:
Within one plan_identity, equal diagnostic evidence produces the same
proof_identity.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.IndependentBatchAxis
messages.description:
dimension joins exactly one GraphDimension. tensor_axis is the single
occurrence of that dimension shared by every public input and output.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.IndependentBatchContract
messages.description:
batch_axis is absent for a singleton graph whose independence proof is
exhaustive but has no public symbolic batch dimension.

fields.name: proof_identity
fields.description:
Within one plan_identity, equal non-identity contract fields produce the
same proof_identity.

fields.name: covered_nodes
fields.description: Equal to GraphPlan.nodes.size.

fields.name: proof_identity
fields.description:
Present because UNSUPPORTED means the proof ran to a canonical semantic
terminal. NOT_EVALUATED below deliberately has no batch proof identity.
Within one plan_identity, equal non-identity refusal fields produce the
same proof_identity.

fields.name: covered_nodes
fields.description: Number of leading schedule nodes accepted before the refusal terminal.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.IndependentBatchNotEvaluated
messages.description:
A prerequisite failure is different from a proof that ran and refused the
graph. In particular, bounded-domain rejection makes batch proof
NOT_EVALUATED rather than UNSUPPORTED. The identity is nonempty and must
equal GraphPlan.shape_domain.unsupported.proof_identity.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphPlan
messages.description:
Canonical order is explicit: dimensions and parameter canonical_name values
use UTF-8 byte order, tensors and weight banks use tensor_index, nodes and
their proof rows use schedule_index, and outputs keep graph declaration
order. Consumers must reject duplicate names or indices and inconsistent
forward/reverse joins.

fields.name: graph_fingerprint
fields.description:
Versioned identity of the exact graph-document byte revision. Treat this
string as opaque: graph_fingerprint distinguishes source revisions, while
plan_identity below identifies their canonicalized declared plan.

fields.name: plan_identity
fields.description:
Stable identity of the complete canonicalized source-declared plan and its
analysis. Registry-declared aliases and nullable nulls converge; an
explicitly declared runtime-default value remains distinct from omission.
Domain and batch evidence carry narrower proof identities below. Bank
declarations participate; concrete residency does not. Two canonical
GraphPlan payloads with equal non-identity fields have the same identity;
this comparison ignores graph_fingerprint and every *_identity field.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphPlanHandle
messages.description:
Success carries a positive id and a complete plan. Failure carries neither
an id nor a partial plan; its report is the only populated result evidence.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GraphPlanInfo
messages.description:
A successful lookup carries the complete immutable plan. A stale, released,
or invalid id carries no plan and is distinguished by report.status.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: Request order is immaterial; every public input appears exactly once.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CallIntent
messages.description:
Absence of CallIntent in ResolveGraphPlan means FORWARD. When present, kind
must not be UNSPECIFIED. changed_inputs is allowed only for
FIXED_INPUT_DEPENDENCY and is canonicalized by tensor name.

fields.name: minimum
fields.description:
Selects the smallest legal value of every symbolic public-input axis,
preserving repeated-symbol equality.

fields.name: exact
fields.description:
Supplies every public input exactly once. Dtype and rank participate in
validation as well as in the resulting canonical signature.

fields.name: bank_residency
fields.description:
Allowed only for a standalone plan. A model-derived plan has immutable
residency selected by LoadModel and rejects a competing override. Request
order is immaterial; entries are matched by bank name.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ResolvedGraphTensor
messages.description:
kind and dtype exactly match the same-index GraphTensor. shape is its exact
concrete specialization. A partial weight bank is the one exception to a
fixed logical extent: axis 0 equals its partial slot count, and per-axis
quantization on axis 0 is selected in that same slot order. Every other
fixed axis and quantization value is unchanged. element_count and byte_size
are checked derivations of shape and dtype, not independent estimates.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecutionSlice
messages.description:
ALL carries every graph node in schedule order. EXPLICIT carries the exact
fixed-input dependency closure in schedule order and may therefore be empty
or equal to the full schedule. cross_call_live_tensors are in canonical
tensor order. These are semantic liveness constraints, not a provider
allocation plan.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ResolvedGraphPlan
messages.description:
symbols contains exactly the dimensions bound during concrete
specialization, as a subsequence of GraphPlan dimension order. Every
symbolic GraphTensor axis is represented; an otherwise-unused declaration
may remain absent. Tensors use tensor_index, outputs retain graph declaration
order, and weight banks use their tensor order. A successful resolution
carries every field below. Failure carries report only; its lineage
identifies the requested GraphPlan when that handle was valid.

fields.name: signature
fields.description:
Opaque canonical binding identity scoped to plan_identity. Caches and
joins use (plan_identity, signature); signature alone is not a graph id.

fields.name: signature_digest
fields.description:
FNV-1a-64 of exactly the UTF-8 bytes carried by signature, with offset
basis 14695981039346656037 and prime 1099511628211. No C terminator or
protobuf framing participates, so every language can reproduce it. This
is a compact integrity check, not a globally unique identity.

fields.name: weight_banks
fields.description: One entry per GraphPlan.weight_banks declaration, in the same tensor order.

fields.name: logical_activation_bytes
fields.description:
Sum of every non-WEIGHT logical tensor's byte_size. Exact aliases are
counted independently; this is deliberately not a physical arena size.

fields.name: weight_bytes
fields.description:
Sum of effective resident WEIGHT bytes after bank residency is applied;
equivalently, the sum of byte_size for every resolved WEIGHT tensor.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Native-host path to a complete SafeTensors file.

fields.name: header_prefix
fields.description:
Complete eight-byte little-endian length prefix followed by exactly the
declared JSON header bytes.

fields.name: file_size
fields.description: Size of the complete logical file: prefix, JSON header, and tensor data.

fields.name: header_prefix
fields.description: On a native host, only HOST, NATIVE_HEAP, and MAPPED_FILE are accepted.

fields.name: file_size
fields.description: Size of the complete logical file: prefix, JSON header, and tensor data.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.InspectSafetensorsRequest
messages.description:
Exactly one self-contained source is required. Its complete header prefix is
at most 67,108,864 bytes. path is native-host only; inline_header is portable
across every transport; header_view is native in-process only. WASM and
REMOTE transports reject path and header_view without dereferencing them.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.SafetensorsDiagnosticEntry
messages.description:
An optional section-relative coordinate: a root member, metadata entry,
tensor declaration, or coverage tensor. Message presence distinguishes the
first entry from a diagnostic that cannot identify one entry.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.SafetensorsDiagnostic
messages.description:
Present only when a supplied header reached the parser and was refused.
entry is present only when the parser identifies one section member.
byte_offset is absolute from the logical file's first byte; zero is also the
meaningful coordinate for prefix/file-wide failures.

fields.name: file_offset
fields.description: Absolute byte offset from the beginning of the complete logical file.

fields.name: declaration_index
fields.description:
Zero-based position of this tensor in the root JSON object; a preceding
__metadata__ member therefore participates in the index.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.SafetensorsInfo
messages.description:
Metadata entries retain their order inside __metadata__. Tensors retain
their root-object declaration order. The parser validates unique member
names and exact, gap-free coverage of the complete tensor data region. A
successful result has no diagnostic. A parser refusal carries diagnostic
and report only; failures that occur before a parser terminal carry report
only.

fields.name: header_json_bytes
fields.description: JSON byte count encoded by the file's leading eight-byte length prefix.

fields.name: data_region_offset
fields.description:
Absolute file offset of the first tensor-data byte. A valid response has
data_region_offset == 8 + header_json_bytes.

fields.name: data_region_bytes
fields.description: A valid response has file_bytes == data_region_offset + data_region_bytes.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ReadSafetensorsRequest
messages.description:
Storage operations are immutable byte transactions and acquire no runtime or
GPU. They retain the complete SafeTensors dtype vocabulary, empty tensors,
arbitrary rank and UTF-8 names/metadata. Runtime graph restrictions apply only
when those tensors are used to construct a Model.

fields.name: names
fields.description:
Empty selects all tensors in file order. Otherwise order follows names;
duplicates and missing names fail the whole call.

fields.name: normalize_f16
fields.description: Convert F16 payloads to F32 in C; other dtypes remain byte-exact.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Empty starts a new file. All source validation precedes editing.

fields.name: edits
fields.description:
Apply in order. Set adds or replaces exact descriptor+bytes (an omitted
Tensor.payload allocates zero-filled storage); removal of
an absent name is a no-op. No partial artifact escapes a failed call.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TensorInitializer
messages.description:
F32 initializers use the former deterministic Mulberry32 stream and
Box-Muller normal transform. Omitted distribution is zeros. Numeric seed
defaults to zero; text seeds use FNV-1a over UTF-16 code units, including
surrogate pairs. Missing mean/stddev/gain are 0/0.02/1 respectively.

fields.name: tensor
fields.description: Nonempty positive concrete shape and F32 dtype are required.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BuildLoraLinearRequest
messages.description:
Append an explicit base + (input @ A @ B) * scale branch to an immutable
graph. No model or GPU is acquired. The original plan stays unchanged.
C validates the complete successor and returns its initialized A/B/scale
weights. Serialize them with WriteSafetensors and load the resulting model
for ordinary training; trainable_names selects A and B only.

fields.name: transpose_base_weight
fields.description: False means base weight [input, output]; true means [output, input].

fields.name: base_operator
fields.description: Empty selects Linear; Linear and MatMul are the supported base operators.

fields.name: name
fields.description:
Empty derives lora_linear_<source node count>. All derived tensor/node
names must be unused. The name is a prefix, never a backend resource ID.

fields.name: select_output
fields.description: Replace public outputs with the new branch output when true.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.BuildRoutedAdapterRequest
messages.description:
Append routed down projection -> GELU -> up projection -> optional Dropout
-> residual Add. Existing weights/routes are named in the source plan.
The result is an ordinary graph, with the same C forward/backward execution.

fields.name: down_weight_name
fields.description: [experts, input, hidden], F32

fields.name: up_weight_name
fields.description: [experts, hidden, input], F32

fields.name: dropout
fields.description: finite [0,1); zero omits the node

fields.name: name
fields.description: default routed_adapter_<source node count>

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QuantizeWeightRequest
messages.description:
Pure conversion of a positive rank-two host F32 matrix. Does not mutate a
Trainer or Model. IMPORTANCE requires a plan and is rejected by this helper.
Supports per-channel I8 RTN and group-32/64/128/256 I2/I3/I4/I8 RTN or MSE_CLIP.

fields.name: preserve_scales
fields.description:
Empty recomputes scales. Otherwise exactly one finite positive scale per
output row/group, in row-major order; only RTN supports supplied scales.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QuantizedWeight
messages.description:
Self-contained storage value. Tensor shapes describe physical storage;
logical_shape is the original canonical [output, input] matrix, including tail.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainerQuantizedWeightBinding
messages.description:
Atomic inference-weight snapshot from persistent F32 training masters.
Template shards retain all unbound tensors and metadata. Bound destinations
must already exist: I8 [output,input], F32 scale [output], I8 zero [output].
Zero points must be symmetric zero. Each master and each destination name
occurs once across the transaction. The transpose and all math execute in C.

fields.name: preserve_scales
fields.description: false recomputes max-abs/127; all-zero rows use 1

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CreateTrainerRequest
messages.description:
A Trainer retains the exact Model revision current at creation. An empty
backend selects the host's default training backend; any named backend is an
exact requirement and is never retried on another backend.

fields.name: checkpoint
fields.description:
Optional private starting state. The checkpoint must match this Model's
exact logical graph and weight descriptors. It supplies its own RNG seed.
Creation validates everything before issuing a Trainer ID. CommitTrainer
publishes restored weights; rollback restores this starting checkpoint
until the first commit. The Model itself is unchanged by restoration.

fields.name: qat
fields.description:
Optional weight-only fake quantization on selected original FP32 nodes.
Omitted preserves ordinary training, or inherits checkpoint.qat on resume.
An explicit policy must match checkpoint.qat when restoring that checkpoint.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QatOptions
messages.description:
Explicit opt-in policy; no automatic layer selection or model-specific tuning.
CPU/WASM and native CUDA. Forward and input gradients use reconstructed low-bit weights;
FP32 masters and optimizer state remain independent. Backward uses clipped
straight-through weight gradients. Scales are refitted from the current
masters each forward pass and receive no gradient. This is weight-only QAT:
it does not simulate A8 activations or learn quantization scales.

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: Nonempty; distinct original node IDs.

fields.name: weights
fields.description:
Required: bits 2/3/4 and RTN or MSE_CLIP. Linear/MatMul use supported
groups; Conv2D uses group_size=0. Unsupported layouts, shared-weight
conflicts, IMPORTANCE and other consumers are refused at creation.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainerShapeOptions
messages.description:
Immutable per-Trainer policy. Limits are positive; omitted fields use the
defaults below. Oversized cache entries execute without being retained.
Capacity covers C activation storage; parameters, gradients, optimizer
slots and backend working memory are reported separately.

fields.name: plan_cache_entries
fields.description: 8; LRU

fields.name: plan_cache_metadata_bytes
fields.description: 1 MiB of live C plan metadata

fields.name: max_activation_capacity_bytes
fields.description: 512 MiB

fields.name: capacity_growth_factor
fields.description: 2; finite and greater than 1

fields.name: targets
fields.description: Dense I32 targets; inline, retained, or transient local storage.

fields.name: row_index
fields.description:
-1 consumes the complete logits tensor. A non-negative value selects a
row-aware loss when the graph supports that execution shape.

fields.name: normalizer
fields.description:
Zero selects the active-label count for a one-microbatch update.
Accumulation windows larger than one require an explicit positive
denominator.

fields.name: kind
fields.description:
Omitted fields keep the Trainer's last successful configuration. A new
Trainer starts with AdamW, lr=0.001, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, epsilon=1e-8,
zero weight decay and no clipping. Changing kind starts from those
defaults before applying the supplied fields. A rejected step changes none.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainStepRequest
messages.description:
A step changes only Trainer-owned working weights, gradients, optimizer
slots, accumulation, and RNG state. It never publishes a Model revision.
One step may be pending per Trainer. While pending, TrainStep, commit,
rollback and export return BUSY. ReleaseTrainer may discard pending work.
Poll GetTrainStep until READY or FAILED before reading metrics or weights.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description:
One atomic complete shape-bearing batch. No Trainer input state exists
outside this request.

fields.name: outputs
fields.description:
Native CPU/GPU only. Capture selected forward outputs before backward or
optimizer mutation. Absent or empty selects none. WebGPU rejects a
nonempty selection before submission; no hidden CPU fallback.

fields.name: diagnostics
fields.description: Opt-in numerical diagnostics. They read values; the update is unchanged.

fields.name: parameter_statistics
fields.description:
Per-parameter statistics in TrainStepResult.gradients.parameters, and the
global gradient norm even when clipping is disabled.

fields.name: locate_nonfinite
fields.description:
On a non-finite loss or gradient, set report.offending_node to the first
forward node producing a non-finite activation, or the first backward node
producing a non-finite gradient. CPU and WASM Trainers only; other
backends name the loss or parameter.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ParameterGradientStatistics
messages.description:
One trainable parameter. Gradient values are those of the accumulation
window after this microbatch, before clipping; a failed step describes its
own microbatch instead.

fields.name: gradient_norm
fields.description: L2 over finite elements

fields.name: gradient_max_abs
fields.description: Finite elements

fields.name: parameter_norm
fields.description: Before this step's update

fields.name: update_norm
fields.description: L2 norm of the change this step applied. Present only when it applied one.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GradientSummary
messages.description:
Gradient numerics of one step. Absent values were not observed. CPU, WASM,
Vulkan and OpenGL Trainers report every field; CUDA reports the global norm,
clipping and a non-finite gradient without naming the parameter; WebGPU
reports none yet.

fields.name: global_norm
fields.description:
L2 norm over every trainable gradient before clipping. Present when an
update is applied with clipping enabled, or statistics were requested.

fields.name: clip_scale
fields.description: The factor clipping multiplied the gradients by, when it changed them.

fields.name: first_nonfinite_parameter
fields.description: The first trainable parameter, in request order, with a non-finite gradient.

fields.name: nonfinite_loss
fields.description: The first loss, in request order, whose value is not finite.

fields.name: update_applied
fields.description:
False for an unfinished accumulation window; the Model is unchanged in
either case.

fields.name: outputs
fields.description:
Owned snapshots are published only by the submitting TrainStep response.
GetTrainStep returns metrics/state only; it never mints duplicate handles.

fields.name: gradients
fields.description: Also present when the step failed on a non-finite loss or gradient.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainStepRef
messages.description:
Queries the most recently accepted step. A later accepted TrainStep retires
the previous result; querying a different microbatch_id returns NOT_FOUND.
Repeated queries are nonblocking and never submit the step again.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExportTrainerWeightsRequest
messages.description:
Export copies the current private Trainer weight shards without publishing
them. Empty output_paths returns SafeTensors bytes in package shard order.
Native callers may instead supply exactly one destination per loaded shard;
then only the report is returned. Export rejects unfinished accumulation.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainerState
messages.description:
A read-only snapshot. Reading state never polls or submits GPU work.
Reset refuses a pending GPU step, and discards only unfinished gradients.

fields.name: qat
fields.description: Absent for ordinary training; immutable resolved policy.

fields.name: qat_workspace_high_water_bytes
fields.description:
Actual peak live QAT fitting/fake-weight/STE workspace bytes. Excludes
immutable policy metadata and ordinary trainer/activation/optimizer storage.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainerShapeState
messages.description:
The actual private C binding and retained memory, independent of backend.
No device work is submitted. Before the first input batch, signature is empty.
Tensor descriptors carry logical extents; arena capacity may be larger.

fields.name: options
fields.description: complete resolved policy

fields.name: activation_gradients
fields.description: F32 logical gradient shapes

fields.name: parameter_gradients
fields.description: F32 logical gradient shapes

fields.name: cached_plans
fields.description:
Least to most recently used. C caches resolved tensor layouts; compiled C
operator code and device pipeline objects are not JavaScript recipes.
Model lineage + backend + signature identify the binding unambiguously.

fields.name: plan_cache_bypasses
fields.description: all admitted bindings left uncached

fields.name: plan_cache_storage_bytes
fields.description:
Actual entry storage including spare slots, separately from the budgeted
metadata of live cache entries. Neither value includes tensor payloads.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TrainerCheckpoint
messages.description:
Portable, self-contained training state, serialized with the generated
protobuf codec. Weight and optimizer bytes use SafeTensors. Graph bytes are
the exact source document, including dimensions and quantization metadata.
No pointers, GPU objects or executable backend plans are persisted.
Version 1 requires optimizer bytes, including an empty state at step zero.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description:
Opaque application metadata, such as tokenizer configuration. C copies it
exactly and does not interpret it as an executable engine instruction.

fields.name: optimizer_config
fields.description:
Required complete configuration. Omitted per-step fields resume these
values after restoration, including when changing execution backend.

fields.name: qat
fields.description: Weight-only policy, retained with the FP32 masters.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExportTrainerCheckpointRequest
messages.description:
Export requires no unfinished accumulation or pending GPU step. Omitted
metadata preserves the imported checkpoint metadata; present bytes replace it.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.WeightFormat
messages.description:
Stored signed weights: per-output-channel I8, Conv-only per-output-channel
I2/I3/I4 in U8 bitstreams, or grouped I2/I3/I4/I8 in I32 words. Codes, scales
and tail encoding follow GraphNodeDefinition. Conv packing is row-local:
U8[O,ceil(K*bits/8)], q+2^(bits-1), least significant bits first. W3 codes
can cross bytes and unused high bits are zero; W2/W4 unused codes encode zero.
Conv geometry is independent of PackedLinear grouping.

fields.name: bits
fields.description: Required: 2, 3, 4 or 8.

fields.name: group_size
fields.description: 0 = per output channel; grouped requires 32, 64, 128 or 256.

fields.name: dtype
fields.description: I8 or U8.

fields.name: reduce_weight_range
fields.description:
Restrict per-channel I8 weight codes to [-64,64] for accumulator headroom.
Rejected for I2/I3/I4 weights, which retain their full signed range.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QuantizationRule
messages.description:
First matching rule wins on original source nodes, before optimization.
Every selector must match at least one node. Unknown/missing selectors and
actions fail creation. Globs support '*' and '?' over the whole node ID.

fields.name: operator_name
fields.description: Canonical operator registry spelling, e.g. Linear.

fields.name: weights
fields.description: Required default for eligible nodes.

fields.name: static_activations
fields.description:
Absent: grouped weight-only storage. Present: static byte-domain regions.
Static weights use group_size=0: I8/RTN on eligible weight nodes, or
I2/I3/I4 with RTN, MSE_CLIP or IMPORTANCE on Conv2D only.
Conv low-bit weights use one scale per output
channel; MSE_CLIP searches 100% through 50% max-absolute range in 1% steps
for Conv I3/I4, and 100% through 1% for I2.
Static low-bit Linear/MatMul and grouped static weights are refused.
IMPORTANCE weights squared errors by observed input second moments; Conv
uses logical im2col inputs including padding and groups. This diagonal
proxy is not full output reconstruction or GPTQ. Weight-only requires
group-32/64/128/256 I2/I3/I4/I8. Existing rule ordering is unchanged.

fields.name: weight_paths
fields.description: Currently exactly one SafeTensors shard.

fields.name: weight_shards
fields.description: Currently exactly one SafeTensors shard.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CalibrationOptions
messages.description:
Shared by static activation and importance observations. Every named profile
requires at least one complete successful batch. Absent/empty means default.

fields.name: cpu_threads
fields.description: Zero = engine default, fixed for this private engine.

fields.name: backend
fields.description:
Empty selects CPU. "cpu" or native "cuda" is an exact requirement; no
backend fallback. Selects calibration execution, not exported arithmetic.
Plans requiring no observations create no executor and report no backend.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CreateQuantizationPlanRequest
messages.description:
C snapshots all source bytes. Subsequent file or caller-buffer changes cannot
affect the plan. Source lengths must fit the transport/address space and
available memory.

fields.name: files
fields.description: Native only.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Native and WASM.

fields.name: calibration
fields.description: Only meaningful when resolved policy requires calibration.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QuantizationNodeInfo
messages.description:
Resolved original node policy. Exposes matching decisions without rerunning
selector interpretation in SDKs. Generated helper/boundary nodes are excluded.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.QuantizationPlanInfo
messages.description: Data only: operations carry their report in the outer response.

fields.name: ready
fields.description:
True when Export prerequisites are met. Export fits scales from the
current sufficient statistics; no finalize operation or input replay.

fields.name: calibration_backend
fields.description:
Actual private observation executor: "cpu" or "cuda". Empty when the
resolved plan needs no calibration. Packing/final fitting remains host work.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CalibrateQuantizationPlanRequest
messages.description:
Executes a complete pass on the selected private backend and atomically adds sufficient
statistics. A rejected batch leaves observations and counters unchanged.
sample_name is required and unique within this plan; an already committed
name is rejected without observing it twice. A failed name may be retried.
Additional successful batches affect only future exports.

fields.name: profile_name
fields.description: Empty = default.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Positive logical examples in this batch.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CalibrationProgress
messages.description: Compact streaming acknowledgement. Full affines/coverage are in Inspect.

fields.name: format
fields.description: volvox.calibration-coverage/v2

fields.name: affines
fields.description: Static activations only.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExportQuantizedModelRequest
messages.description:
Exports from current observations without mutating them. Repeated byte
exports without calibration produce identical artifacts. Failure does not
invalidate the plan. Returned bytes survive release of the plan.

fields.name: output_files
fields.description:
Absent: return bytes. Native paths: graph.json and sibling *.safetensors.
Existing files are never overwritten. WASM only supports returned bytes.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryOwnerRef
messages.description: Opaque owner identity. Public handles use decimal spelling; process scope uses "0".

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryByteSize
messages.description:
Message presence, unlike a proto3 scalar default, distinguishes an omitted
measurement from an exact zero in every generated language.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryBoundTerm
messages.description:
One disjoint accounting unit in a compile-time peak case. term_id is unique
within its case. Shared/aliased physical storage appears once in a case
even when multiple objects consume it.
