messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryPeakCase
messages.description:
Every term in one case is simultaneously resident and physically disjoint.
A present case contains at least one term; exact-zero cases use a present
zero-byte term. total_bytes must equal the checked sum of upper_bound_bytes.
Cases are alternatives: callers take their maximum and never sum case
totals.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryBoundProof
messages.description:
maximum_bytes must equal max(cases.total_bytes) when cases are present.
Empty cases allow a provider to publish its existing coarse attestation
before it implements detailed terms. limit_bytes is absent when the backend
or device exposes no meaningful limit.

fields.name: budget_domain_id
fields.description:
Stable provider-defined accounting domain, for example
"provider-resident", "activation-capacity", or "wasm-linear". It
disambiguates independent limits with the same canonical kind.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryDomainAttestation
messages.description:
Compile-time evidence for the complete bounded shape domain. Bounds are
computed proof, not observed allocation or RSS/VRAM measurements. Consumers
accept only the canonical proof/resource protocols named below and require
at least one bound. They reject missing maxima, missing case/term byte
presence, duplicate (budget_domain_id, kind), duplicate case/term IDs,
checked-sum or max mismatches, and a maximum above its present limit. Empty
cases are allowed only for a coarse maximum supplied by an existing
provider attestation.

fields.name: proof_protocol
fields.description: Exactly "canonical-symbolic-domain-proof/v1" in format v1.

fields.name: resource_protocol
fields.description: Exactly "bounded-resource-maxima/v1" in format v1.

fields.name: host_time_ns
fields.description:
Host execution and output submission; excludes asynchronous device completion.
Includes synchronous device waits performed by the backend. Not kernel time.

fields.name: output_bytes
fields.description: Logical output payload; never process RSS or total allocator residency.

fields.name: host_time_ns
fields.description: Host compilation duration measured with the monotonic clock.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.RecordCount
messages.description: A bounded collection: records kept and records lost to capacity or errors.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceOptions
messages.description:
What to collect. StartTraceRequest supplies it; TraceInfo echoes the
effective options with defaults resolved.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: One detail level for host and device observations.

fields.name: device_timing
fields.description:
GPU elapsed time; the engine chooses the timestamp mechanism. False creates
no GPU timing resources. Node timing may split passes or add barriers.

fields.name: memory
fields.description: Allocation history, allocator peaks and memory in resource snapshots.

fields.name: utilization
fields.description: Process CPU time and hardware-wide GPU utilization in resource snapshots.

fields.name: execution_plans
fields.description: Immutable tensor/schedule metadata for each concrete context layout.

fields.name: capacity_bytes
fields.description: Collector storage, allocated once at start, including event metadata.

fields.name: sample_interval_ns
fields.description:
Minimum spacing of resource snapshots taken at operation boundaries. There
is no sampler thread; this is not a guaranteed sampling period.

fields.name: external
fields.description: Ranges and labels for vendor profilers and GPU debuggers.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceExternalOptions
messages.description:
External profiler and debugger integration. Only operations admitted while
the trace is COLLECTING are annotated; ordinary execution never is.
Numerical results and backend selection are unchanged.

fields.name: annotations
fields.description:
NVTX ranges for operations, and with detail NODES for nodes and training
phases (native builds with a GPU backend; Nsight Systems/Compute), plus a
label around each node's device commands: VK_EXT_debug_utils (Vulkan),
KHR_debug groups (OpenGL) and debug groups in labeled passes (WebGPU) for
RenderDoc, vendor tools and WebGPU validation messages.

fields.name: capture
fields.description:
Ask a RenderDoc instance already injected into the process to capture from
the first traced operation until StopTrace. Headless compute has no present
call to delimit a frame. A missing tool is reported, never an error.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceExternalCoverage
messages.description:
What one vendor-tool mechanism did for this trace. AVAILABLE means the engine
emitted through it; it does not prove that a tool recorded anything.

fields.name: mechanism
fields.description: nvtx, vk_debug_utils, khr_debug, webgpu_debug_group or renderdoc.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceDeviceIntervalCounts
messages.description: Device intervals successfully recorded for one backend, by scope.

fields.name: programs
fields.description: Engine-owned dispatches, not a complete driver-level kernel inventory.

fields.name: calibrated
fields.description: Intervals placed on the host clock by calibration or by causal bounds.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceHostActivityCounts
messages.description: Host activity observations for one backend.

fields.name: synchronizations
fields.description: Blocking host calls.

fields.name: completions
fields.description: Asynchronous completions; not CPU busy time.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceDeviceCoverage
messages.description: One row per encountered built-in backend. StartTrace probes no device.

fields.name: node_timing_available
fields.description:
Observed on at least one encountered device path; not a promise that every
operation has node/program coverage.

fields.name: splits_passes
fields.description: Instrumentation changes that may alter the measured execution schedule.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Counts include reserved pending slots until READY; then they are final.

fields.name: active_operations
fields.description: Host scopes and pending asynchronous host completions.

fields.name: host_clock_resolution_ns
fields.description:
Effective host clock resolution. Absent when unknown (for example, browser
clock quantization). Nanosecond storage does not imply that precision.

fields.name: collector_bytes
fields.description: Requested collector storage, including snapshots and plans.

fields.name: external
fields.description: One row per external mechanism the trace attempted.

fields.name: capture_origin_ns
fields.description:
The VxPlatformService monotonic time of capture-relative zero, to align
events with external timelines such as browser DevTools.

fields.name: start_ns
fields.description:
Monotonic host time relative to capture start. A COMPLETION activity measures
asynchronous completion latency, not time occupying the submitting thread.

fields.name: host_observed_ns
fields.description: Host marker observed before device work is encoded/submitted, not GPU start.

fields.name: correlation
fields.description: Absent when no valid relation to the capture-relative host clock exists.

fields.name: earliest_start_ns
fields.description:
Range for the device interval's start on the capture-relative host clock.
It includes calibration uncertainty; it is not a precise start time.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description:
Opaque identities, meaningful only within this capture. No native handles.
Devices from different backend APIs are not asserted to be the same GPU.

fields.name: submission_id
fields.description: Absent when the observation is not tied to one known submission/batch.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Bytes passed to this copy, including required padding.

fields.name: schedule_index
fields.description:
Index in the executable schedule. Fused duration belongs to this work;
it must never be divided among eliminated source nodes.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceProgram
messages.description:
A measured engine program invocation. A CUDA program can launch several
internal kernels; this is not a CUPTI kernel activity record.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Host operations use the RPC method name, for example "Execute".

fields.name: track_id
fields.description: Host thread; device intervals annotate this submitter.

fields.name: node
program
fields.description: Presence distinguishes a program interval from its enclosing node/pass.

fields.name: tensor_name
fields.description:
A known work target, e.g. the parameter updated by an optimizer. Empty when
unknown or work spans multiple tensors.

fields.name: copy
fields.description: Present exactly on COPY events.

fields.name: plan_id
fields.description: The execution plan of this work (GetTracePlan). Absent when not captured.

fields.name: live_bytes
fields.description: This allocator's tracked requested capacity after the event.

fields.name: timestamp_ns
fields.description: Capture-relative host time.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceAllocatorMemory
messages.description:
Requested capacities of observed owned allocations, not physical residency.
Inventories are PARTIAL: metadata, driver allocations and unvisited owners
can be absent. Counters are additive only within their stated allocator.
Existing resources are inventoried when an owner first participates. A peak
covers observed allocator transitions from that point until StopTrace.

fields.name: accounting_complete
fields.description:
False if the bounded live-identity table overflowed. Byte counters then
describe only the tracked subset. Event loss alone does not lose counters.

fields.name: scope
fields.description:
RUNTIME aggregates observed owners of the captured runtime. BACKEND_SHARED
includes every runtime using the same host bridge (currently WebGPU).
Never add BACKEND_SHARED counters from simultaneous runtime captures.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecutionPlan
messages.description:
Immutable metadata for one concrete context layout. Tensor lifetimes are
planner-derived schedule intervals, not measured resident device memory.
Plan and event IDs are capture-local; source IDs are model graph node IDs.
A plan remains readable after context/model release and never retains tensors.

fields.name: placement_complete
fields.description: Every tensor with storage names its allocation.

fields.name: source_mapping_complete
fields.description: Every step names all source nodes it executes.

fields.name: source_node_ids
fields.description:
Source graph nodes executed by this step: the node itself and any node
fused into it. Debug node selectors match these IDs.

fields.name: inputs
fields.description: ExecutionPlanTensor.tensor_id values.

fields.name: skipped
fields.description: Eliminated by optimization; executes no kernel.

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Work one call implies at these shapes, including a fused peer's.

fields.name: phase
fields.description:
Training debug plans: which part of the step this entry performs.
UNSPECIFIED for inference plans.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.StepCost
messages.description:
Counts, not measurements. Multiply-accumulates cover matrix products,
convolutions and attention, float or integer (one FLOP-style operation pair
each). Other arithmetic is one operation per output element; exp, tanh and
erf-class functions are also counted as transcendental. Data movement has
no arithmetic. Bytes are the logical sizes of the step's inputs (including
weights) and outputs: a lower bound on memory traffic.

fields.name: allocation_id
fields.description: Absent if the backend did not expose this tensor's physical placement.

fields.name: first_step
fields.description:
Inclusive schedule interval. Inputs start before step zero; retained
inputs/outputs may remain live across calls. Absent lifetime is unknown.

fields.name: source_tensor_name
fields.description:
The float tensor this value represents: a PTQ package records it for each
renamed activation. Empty when the name already is the source name.

fields.name: gradient_of
fields.description:
Training debug plans: the tensor whose gradient this is. Gradient tensors
are named "<tensor>.grad".

fields.name: resource_snapshots
fields.description: Capture-relative times, oldest first.

fields.name: plan_id
fields.description: TraceEvent.plan_id. Plans are numbered from 1 to TraceInfo.plans.count.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceSummaryRow
messages.description:
Rows never mix host and device time, or nodes, programs and calls: those
intervals overlap and are not additive. A program interval is not added to
its node. Truncated metadata is excluded and counted.

fields.name: lineage
fields.description: Model, compiled model and context identities.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Operator, RPC method or activity name.

fields.name: p95_ns
fields.description: Nearest rank.

fields.name: share
fields.description:
Share of total_ns among rows with the same lineage, plan, backend, phase
and domain. Not application latency or utilization.

fields.name: cost_per_call
fields.description: Node rows: the plan step's cost for one call.

fields.name: achieved_flops_per_second
fields.description:
Achieved rates over this row's time: 2 x multiply-accumulates per second,
and step bytes per second. Present when every call has a known cost and
the time measures that work: device intervals, or host nodes on CPU/WASM.
Absent for decode steps, whose rows run only part of the plan's shape.
Rates, not utilization: the engine does not know peak throughput.

fields.name: copy_bytes
fields.description: Activity rows: bytes copied.

fields.name: rows
fields.description: total_ns descending

fields.name: truncated
fields.description: More rows than max_rows.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Copied from TraceInfo: lost events make totals partial.

fields.name: excluded_events
fields.description: Truncated metadata.

fields.name: page_size
fields.description:
Source events serialized per page. Trace metadata is added to the first
and last page; JSON page bytes vary.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
A UTF-8 fragment. Concatenating every page from an empty page_token until
next_page_token is empty produces one Chrome Trace Event JSON document.
Repeating a request returns the same bytes.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.AnnotateTraceRequest
messages.description:
An application-defined range, like torch.profiler.record_function or
jax.profiler.TraceAnnotation. Times use the VxPlatformService monotonic clock
(GetMonotonicTime), not capture-relative time.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryAllocation
messages.description:
One backing allocation. IDs are local to this snapshot; no pointer is exposed.
Aliases and tensor placements refer to allocation_id and add no storage.
Capacity is allocator/API storage, not physical RSS or resident VRAM.

fields.name: trace_allocation_id
fields.description:
Present only when a captured plan can identify the matching allocator
event in this trace. Snapshot-local IDs alone never join different pages.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.MemorySnapshot
messages.description:
Known owned allocations reachable from the selected scope. Shared backing
allocations occur once. A PARTIAL inventory omits unclassified owners,
driver-private storage and retired handles that the scope cannot reach.

fields.name: unconsumed_result_bytes
fields.description: These accounting values overlap allocations and are not additive to them.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.WasmMemorySnapshot
messages.description:
Exact partition of this WASM module's linear memory at observation time.
linear = allocated + free + allocator_metadata + module_prefix + page_slack
+ untracked. Untracked covers raw heap reservations outside malloc.
All runtimes in the module share this heap. Free bytes may be fragmented;
they are not the unused tensor ranges inside an allocated arena.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ProcessMemorySnapshot
messages.description:
OS process observations overlap all engine accounting. They are never summed
with allocation capacities or WASM memory. Peak covers the process lifetime.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ProcessCpuSample
volvoxai.v1.GpuResourceSample
messages.description:
Hardware-wide driver telemetry (nvidia-smi style), including work from other
applications. Ratios describe the driver's preceding sample window, not this
request or model. GPU utilization is not SM occupancy or percentage of peak
FLOPS; memory utilization is memory-interface busy time, not used/capacity.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: Stable driver device UUID when available.

fields.name: sampling_window_ns
fields.description: Absent when the driver omits it.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ResourceSnapshot
messages.description:
Independent observations, not an atomic system snapshot. Times are monotonic
host nanoseconds; trace snapshots use the capture-relative clock. CPU and GPU
utilization remain separate from host spans and timestamp-query intervals.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.GetResourceSnapshotRequest
messages.description:
Exactly one scope. module selects every known owner in this engine module,
not every engine loaded in the process. External observations always retain
their actual scope.

fields.name: include_device
fields.description: Opt-in driver sampling; never initializes a compute backend.

fields.name: max_allocations
fields.description: Truncation is explicit in MemorySnapshot.truncated.

fields.name: node_ids
fields.description:
Source graph node IDs (ExecutionPlanStep.source_node_ids). Empty selects
every step. Unknown IDs fail creation.

fields.name: tensor_names
fields.description:
Executable tensor names (ExecutionPlanTensor.name). Empty selects every
tensor. Both selectors apply. Unknown names fail creation.

fields.name: values
fields.description:
Statistics are always captured for selected tensors. Raw bytes are
retained only when values is true. Unselected tensors are never copied.

fields.name: constants
fields.description:
Immutable weights and initializers among the selected inputs. False keeps
them out of snapshots, which otherwise repeat unchanged model storage.

fields.name: gradients
fields.description: Training targets: gradients among the selected tensors.

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.description:
Bounds session metadata, retained snapshots and capture staging together.
Excludes the private execution context, shared weights and transport reply
copies. Creation fails if fixed metadata cannot fit.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.CreateDebugSessionRequest
messages.description:
Inference targets attach to the same Graph context and transaction used by
Execute. A debug session reserves it until session release. Training retains
its existing independent Trainer transaction.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.description:
DebugSessionInfo.revision last observed. A stale value fails with
REVISION_CONFLICT without executing; a RUNNING session fails with BUSY.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.description: Same contract as StepDebugSessionRequest.expected_revision.

fields.name: break_before_nodes
fields.description:
Pause before any step executing one of these source node IDs. The step
the session is paused at runs once, so continuing makes progress. Applies
to this command only; unknown IDs fail without executing.

fields.name: break_on_nonfinite
fields.description:
Pause after a step whose captured outputs contain NaN or infinity, like
jax_debug_nans or torch.autograd.detect_anomaly. Uses output statistics,
so the step's outputs must be selected by DebugCapture.

fields.name: report
fields.description: Outcome of this RPC only. A failing model is reported in `failure`.

fields.name: revision
fields.description:
Changes whenever the session state changes. Pass it as expected_revision.
This is a version, not a position; the position is next_step.

fields.name: capture_complete
fields.description: True when every selected observation was captured.

fields.name: failure
fields.description:
Present when state is FAILED: why the model's execution failed, including
the offending node. Published observations remain readable.

fields.name: result_available
fields.description:
True for a completed Execute target whose output packet has not been
taken. Queries never issue output buffer IDs.

fields.name: modified
fields.description:
SetDebugTensor replaced a value: observations no longer reproduce an
ordinary run.

fields.name: train_step_result
fields.description: Train-step target, once COMPLETED: what the TrainStep would have returned.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugTensorStatistics
messages.description:
Statistics describe raw storage values, including quantized integer values.
Finite-only population variance; numeric fields are absent with no finite
elements. Counts account for every element when statistics are present.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: Names an immutable copy; pass it to ReadDebugTensor.

fields.name: tensor_id
fields.description: ExecutionPlanTensor.tensor_id, not a storage address.

fields.name: quantization
fields.description:
Present for quantized tensors. Statistics stay in storage units; apply
these parameters to obtain real values.

fields.name: real_statistics
fields.description: Statistics of dequantized real values. Present for quantized tensors.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugEvent
messages.description: Snapshots taken at one point of one schedule entry.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ListDebugEventsResponse
messages.description:
Events are append-only. An empty next_page_token means the end of the events
published so far; a RUNNING session can publish more.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugDecodeSlot
messages.description: One slot of a decode target. Rows are logical token positions.

fields.name: length_before
fields.description: Tokens the slot holds before this operation and after it completes.

fields.name: write_begin
fields.description:
Rows [write_begin, write_end) this operation writes; none for an empty slot.
Until a cache is `written`, those rows still hold their previous values.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugKVCache
messages.description:
A self-attention KV cache: the rows one causal attention step reads as its
key or value operand. A fused QKV operand exposes its key and value columns
as two caches over one tensor.

fields.name: cache_id
fields.description: Session-scoped; pass to ReadDebugKVCache.

fields.name: tensor_id
fields.description: ExecutionPlanTensor.tensor_id of the storage.

fields.name: attention_step
fields.description: The attention step that reads these rows.

fields.name: token_capacity
fields.description: Rows per slot.

fields.name: token_shape
fields.description: Shape of one row as returned by reads.

fields.name: page_tokens
fields.description: Tokens per page when the storage is a paged pool; zero when contiguous.

fields.name: writer_step
fields.description: The step that writes this operation's rows, when the operation runs it.

fields.name: written
fields.description: True once writer_step has executed at the current stop.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ReadDebugKVCacheResponse
messages.description:
Raw little-endian storage rows, never implicitly dequantized. The read is
complete when token_offset plus the returned rows equals token_count.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: [rows, token_shape...]

fields.name: token_count
fields.description: Readable rows of this slot: its length_after.

fields.name: statistics
fields.description: Of the returned rows, in storage units.

fields.name: quantization
fields.description: Present for quantized storage.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.description: Same contract as StepDebugSessionRequest.expected_revision.

fields.name: tensor_id
fields.description: ExecutionPlanTensor.tensor_id of an input of next_step.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The tensor's dtype and shape; its name is ignored.

messages.name: volvoxai.v1.ReadDebugTensorResponse
messages.description:
Raw little-endian storage bytes, never implicitly dequantized. Reading is
complete when read_offset + data length equals size_bytes. Only AVAILABLE
snapshots have bytes.

values.name: TOKENIZATION_MODE_AUTO
values.description:
HF profiles use their admitted tokenizer.json pipeline. Legacy profiles
use greedy byte matching without valid merges, otherwise Unicode
letter/number/punctuation/whitespace pretokenization and ranked BPE.

values.name: TOKENIZATION_MODE_BPE_WORD
values.description: Apply BPE to the whole text as one chunk, without pretokenization.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.BatchWorkKind
enums.description:
C owns compatibility grouping, admission, token budgets, padding, slot/page
reservations, prefix reuse and retirement. The application supplies work and
executes each returned dispatch using its chosen worker. There is no product
TypeScript scheduler. Inference workers can use VxInferenceService; page plans
here describe worker-owned storage and are not an ExecutionContext binding.

values.name: BATCH_WORK_STATE_UNKNOWN
values.description: invalid ID or evicted terminal record

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.DataType
enums.description:
Canonical tensor element/storage vocabulary. Enum membership describes a
representation, not execution support: each operation validates the subset
it can execute. Keep existing numbers stable and append future dtypes.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.ResultState
enums.description:
Training microbatch completion. Inference Execute/Generate replies only
after completion and exposes no public Result capability.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecutionMode
enums.description:
Runtime dispatch ownership. DIRECT bypasses Runtime scheduling entirely and
rejects every VxSchedulerService operation. SCHEDULED permits both direct
Execute/Generate calls and scheduled Submit calls. CreateRuntime defaults to DIRECT when
execution_mode is absent.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.BuildProfile
enums.description:
Which build profile a library was composed with. An inference build does
not register VxTrainingService or VxQuantizationService.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.TransportProfile
enums.description:
IN_PROCESS accepts BorrowedBuffer descriptors in its local address space.
REMOTE accepts inline bytes and server-owned BufferView capabilities, but
rejects local pointers, native resources, access mappings and DLPack. A
network adapter must enforce this boundary before forwarding native calls.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.AffineScheme
enums.description: Static activation affine convention. Symmetric is the default.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.WeightAlgorithm
enums.description: How codes and scales are fitted; independent of their stored representation.

values.name: WEIGHT_ALGORITHM_RTN
values.description: absmax, round-to-nearest ties-to-even

values.name: WEIGHT_ALGORITHM_MSE_CLIP
values.description: data-free clipping scale search

values.name: WEIGHT_ALGORITHM_IMPORTANCE
values.description: input-channel second-moment weighted fitting

values.name: NATIVE_STATUS_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED
values.description: A BorrowedBuffer or local interop request reached an incompatible transport.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.OperationCode
enums.description:
Machine-readable detail. Status describes the broad outcome; code preserves
the specific cause independently of human-readable message text.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_DEBUG_SESSION_FINISHED
values.description: The debug session is COMPLETED, CANCELLED or FAILED and accepts no command.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_TRAINING_LOSS_NONFINITE
values.description: A training loss is not finite. TrainStepResult.gradients names the loss.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_TRAINING_GRADIENT_NONFINITE
values.description: A gradient is not finite. TrainStepResult.gradients names the parameter.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_TOKENIZER_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED
values.description: The immutable tokenizer profile does not implement the requested operation.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_TOKEN_ID_UNKNOWN
values.description: A ByteLevel decode request contains an ID absent from its immutable table.

values.name: OPERATION_CODE_MODEL_SOURCE_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH
values.description: An accepted source snapshot disagrees with its declared length or digest.

values.name: OPERATION_STAGE_PTQ_AUTHOR
values.description:
Deriving the quantized template, which happens before a plan exists and
so cannot report itself as PTQ_CREATE.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.NativeResourceKind
enums.description: Resource representation is independent of physical placement and mapping.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.DimensionKind
enums.description:
One axis of a logical bounded tensor. A FIXED axis has an empty symbol,
min == max, and multiple_of == 1. A SYMBOLIC axis has a non-empty canonical
symbol and positive min/max/multiple_of values. Mixed states are rejected.

Zero is deliberately UNSPECIFIED rather than FIXED so a zero-initialized
descriptor fails validation instead of silently reading as a fixed axis of
extent zero.

values.name: API_RULE_KIND_HANDLE_STATE
values.description:
The handle named by `fields` must be in one of `states` (enum value names
of the handle's state enum), as reported by its Get method.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.PackedArithmetic
enums.description:
Internal arithmetic of PackedLinear only. Graph boundaries and bias are F32.
Compilation resolves UNSPECIFIED to F32, independent of backend, and pins the
result for the executable lifetime. Backend fallback preserves this contract.
Parallel reductions and FMA may differ in their final FP32 rounding; none of
these values promises bitwise equality across devices or execution shapes.

values.name: PACKED_ARITHMETIC_DYNAMIC_I8
values.description: Per-row dynamic I8 activations; exact integer group dots, F32 scale/sum.

values.name: PACKED_ARITHMETIC_F16
values.description: Input and reconstructed weight round to IEEE F16, then F32 accumulation.

values.name: PACKED_ARITHMETIC_F32
values.description:
F32 operands/accumulation. Reassociation/FMA allowed; reduced-precision
operand conversion (including TF32) is not allowed.

values.name: PACKED_ARITHMETIC_F32_FAST
values.description:
Explicitly permits compensated TF32 hi+lo activation decomposition with
integer weight operands and F32 accumulation/group scaling. May use F32
kernels on other hardware or shapes. Never selects F16 or dynamic I8.

values.name: PACKED_ARITHMETIC_DYNAMIC_I4
values.description:
Reserved selection for future per-row dynamic I4 activation arithmetic.
No backend implements it in this release: CompileModel returns
BACKEND_UNSUPPORTED without creating an executable or selecting another
arithmetic. This value does not change weight storage or static affines.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.ExecutionEffect
enums.description:
Typed model execution metadata is required in the graph document's
"execution" member, using these message field names and enum values. The
same contract survives loading, GetModelInfo, planning, edits and export.

values.name: SAMPLING_MODE_RANDOM
values.description:
Seeded categorical selection with the options in AutoregressiveExecution.
Backend admission remains explicit; no hidden host numerical fallback.

values.name: REQUEST_FRESHNESS_ALL
values.description: Every admitted request remains eligible until cancelled or completed.

values.name: REQUEST_FRESHNESS_LATEST
values.description:
A request with the same compiled route and nonzero stream key is
superseded by a newer admitted LATEST request. Queued replacement is
transactional: equal payload storage may be reused across dynamic shapes,
while a larger payload requires temporary byte-budget headroom. Already
submitted work remains physical but its result is discarded at
completion.

values.name: REQUEST_FRESHNESS_DROP_IF_LATE
values.description: Refuse or retire queued/completed work whose monotonic deadline elapsed.

values.name: CALL_INTENT_KIND_FORWARD
values.description: Execute the complete graph; retain no activation across calls.

values.name: CALL_INTENT_KIND_FIXED_INPUT_DEPENDENCY
values.description:
Recompute the exact dependency closure of changed_inputs and report the
non-weight tensors that selected work must read or preserve across calls.

values.name: CALL_INTENT_KIND_ALL_CROSS_CALL_LIVE
values.description:
Execute the complete graph while treating every non-weight tensor as
cross-call live.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.ParameterExportMode
enums.description:
CPU shared read views retain the trainer and block trainer mutation until
all handles and access leases are released. GPU shared views are rejected;
native GPU parameter snapshots remain on the backend. Snapshots do not block
mutation. names must be a nonempty list of model weight tensor names.

values.name: MEMORY_SPACE_DEVICE
values.description: An API-visible device allocation whose physical placement is unknown.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryOwnerKind
enums.description:
The lifetime owner is not necessarily the object currently using a
resource. In particular, contexts can consume one immutable
COMPILED_MODEL-owned weight allocation without owning copies of it.

values.name: MEMORY_OWNER_KIND_TRAINER
values.description:
Full-profile private authoring owners. Inference projections omit these
names while the shared protobuf wire vocabulary retains them.

values.name: MEMORY_OWNER_KIND_GRAPH_PLAN
values.description:
Logical planning runs in every profile; VxPlanningService, which publishes
plan handles, is full-only.

values.name: MEMORY_OWNER_KIND_MODULE
values.description: Every known owner in one engine module.

values.name: MEMORY_RESOURCE_ROLE_TRAINING_WORKING_WEIGHTS
values.description:
Full-profile private authoring state. These are distinct from immutable
published WEIGHTS and ordinary inference ACTIVATION/SCRATCH resources.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryBoundKind
enums.description:
Each bound kind is an independent number. Bounds of different kinds are
never summed. A decode bound, for example, is an alternative to the
ordinary resident bound rather than an additional allocation.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.MemoryInventoryKind
enums.description:
Whether all live backing allocations in the stated inventory scope are
represented. COMPLETE concerns inventory coverage, not physical residency,
tensor liveness or other scopes. An empty COMPLETE inventory means no live
allocations in that scope; an empty PARTIAL inventory remains unknown.

values.name: TRACE_DETAIL_BASIC
values.description: Host operations and, when device timing is enabled, existing device passes.

values.name: TRACE_DETAIL_NODES
values.description:
Also collect executable nodes, training work and supported GPU programs.
Actual pass/node/program coverage is reported in TraceInfo.devices.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.TracePhase
enums.description:
The work that actually executed, independently of its host/device clock.
UNSPECIFIED includes outer operations and observations with no known phase.

values.name: TRACE_PHASE_GRADIENT
values.description: Initialization, accumulation, norm and clipping.

values.name: TRACE_STATE_DRAINING
values.description: Stopped; accepted host operations or device timestamps are still pending.

values.name: TRACE_STATE_READY
values.description: Immutable and readable.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceTimingSupport
enums.description:
Timestamp support observed on a backend's encountered device paths.
UNSPECIFIED means no device timing path was encountered.

values.name: TRACE_TIMING_SUPPORT_MIXED
values.description: The same backend encountered devices/passes with different support.

values.name: TRACE_CLOCK_METHOD_CALIBRATED
values.description:
A device clock sample is related to host time with measured uncertainty.
Mapping is local to this pass; it is not a permanent clock conversion.

values.name: TRACE_CLOCK_METHOD_BOUNDED
values.description: Causal submission/completion bounds only, not clock calibration.

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_UNSPECIFIED
values.description: Memory events carry no activity.

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_COMPUTE
values.description: Operator or kernel execution (CUPTI KERNEL, Kineto cpu_op/kernel).

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_COPY
values.description: CUPTI MEMCPY.

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_SUBMIT
values.description: Command submission (Vulkan/WebGPU submit, CUDA launch).

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_SYNCHRONIZE
values.description: Host blocking call, including scheduling overhead (CUPTI SYNCHRONIZATION).

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_COMPLETION
values.description:
Observed asynchronous completion (fence, onSubmittedWorkDone); not CPU
blocking time.

values.name: TRACE_ACTIVITY_ANNOTATION
values.description: Application range from AnnotateTrace.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.TraceMemoryAction
enums.description:
EXISTING introduces an allocation at the first inventory of its owner; it
does not claim the allocation happened during this trace. Identities are
opaque and unique within the trace, including after address reuse.

values.name: COST_STATUS_EXACT
values.description: Closed-form count for the concrete shapes.

values.name: COST_STATUS_ESTIMATED
values.description:
An upper or representative count: attention with masked keys, packed
weights, normalization and windowed reductions.

values.name: COST_STATUS_UNKNOWN
values.description: No model for this operator; the counts are zero, not measured zero.

values.name: TRACE_SUMMARY_GROUPING_NODE
values.description: One row per executable node of a plan ("slow nodes").

values.name: TRACE_SUMMARY_GROUPING_OPERATOR
values.description: One row per backend, phase and operator type.

values.name: TRACE_SUMMARY_GROUPING_OPERATION
values.description: One row per public call, such as Execute or TrainStep.

values.name: TRACE_SUMMARY_GROUPING_ACTIVITY
values.description: Copies, submissions, blocking waits and asynchronous completions.

values.name: TRACE_TIME_DOMAIN_HOST
values.description: TraceEvent.host spans

values.name: TRACE_TIME_DOMAIN_DEVICE
values.description: TraceEvent.device elapsed intervals

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugStopReason
enums.description: Why a session is PAUSED (DAP StoppedEvent.reason). UNSPECIFIED otherwise.

values.name: DEBUG_STOP_REASON_ENTRY
values.description: Created, before step zero.

values.name: DEBUG_STOP_REASON_NONFINITE
values.description: A captured output of the previous step contains NaN or infinity.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugPoint
enums.description: When an event's snapshots were taken relative to its schedule entry.

values.name: DEBUG_POINT_BEFORE
values.description: Input snapshots.

values.name: DEBUG_POINT_AFTER
values.description: Output snapshots.

values.name: DEBUG_TENSOR_STATUS_AVAILABLE
values.description: Statistics and raw bytes.

values.name: DEBUG_TENSOR_STATUS_STATISTICS_ONLY
values.description: DebugCapture.values was false.

values.name: DEBUG_TENSOR_STATUS_OPTIMIZED_OUT
values.description: Eliminated by optimization (gdb's "<optimized out>"). No value exists.

values.name: DEBUG_TENSOR_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED
values.description: No statistics for this dtype.

enums.name: volvoxai.v1.DebugKVRole
enums.description: Which attention operand a cache feeds.
